grounding.description: Use your senses to gently bring yourself back to the present moment.
steps: Name 5 things you can see right now.
Name 4 things you can physically touch.
Name 3 things you can hear.
Name 2 things you can smell.
Name 1 thing you can taste.

gratitude.description: List three things you are grateful for right now.
prompts: Something that made you smile today.
A person who brings you comfort.
Something in your body that is working well.

joyCapture.description: Capture what is making you happy. Writing it down makes it stick.
prompts: What made you smile or laugh today?
What are you most excited about right now?

savoring.description: Savoring helps you hold onto positive emotions by slowing down and noticing them.
steps: Close your eyes. Replay a happy moment from today in full detail.
Notice how your body feels right now — warmth, lightness, ease.
Smile gently. Let the feeling linger a little longer.

energyBoost.description: Quick physical resets to shake off the fog and reclaim your energy.
steps: Stand up and stretch your arms above your head for 10 seconds.
Take 5 deep breaths — in through your nose, out through your mouth.
Shake out your hands and roll your shoulders back.
Splash cold water on your face or hold an ice cube.

curiosity.description: Curiosity pulls you out of autopilot. Answer these to re-engage with the world.
prompts: What is one thing you would like to learn more about today?
What is something around you that you have never really looked at closely?
If you could ask anyone one question right now, what would it be?

mindfulPause.description: A quick reset to bring you back to the present moment.
steps: Pause whatever you are doing. Sit still for a moment.
Notice three sounds around you without judging them.
Feel the weight of your body on the chair or floor.
Take one slow, deep breath and let it out gently.

bodyScan.description: Slowly scan your body from head to toe. Release tension wherever you find it.
steps: Close your eyes. Start at the top of your head. Notice any tension.
Move your attention to your face and jaw. Let them soften.
Drop your shoulders. Let your arms feel heavy.
Notice your chest and belly. Let your breathing slow naturally.
Scan down to your legs and feet. Feel them grounded on the floor.

selfCompassion.description: Kristin Neff's self-compassion practice — be your own best friend for a moment.
steps: Place a hand on your chest. Acknowledge: "This is a hard moment."
Remind yourself: "Struggle is part of being human. I am not alone in this."
Say to yourself: "May I be kind to myself right now."
Take a slow breath and let yourself feel whatever comes up.

comfortList.description: Build a comfort toolkit. Knowing what helps makes hard moments easier to navigate.
prompts: A place where you feel safe.
A song, show, or book that comforts you.
Something small you can do for yourself today.
